company_info.description: Wize Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in gaming business in Japan and internationally. It operates game platform. The company engages in the production business of games and digital contents; IP investment development projects; lifestyle Ip business; and digital IP business; and cooking contents business. The company was formerly known as Mobcast Holdings Inc. and changed its name to Wize Inc. in April 2026. Wize Inc. was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.
